_note: Starting roles, draft-picked with no duplicates. Effects are read by id in the engine.

roles.name: Banker
roles.summary: 5% interest per lap on cash above $1,000. Pays double property tax.

roles.name: Diplomat
roles.summary: Airport fees halved. Section rent bonus capped at +50%.

roles.name: Industrialist
roles.summary: Build costs 20% cheaper. Pays 1.5x utility build fees to meters they do not own.

roles.name: Civil Servant
roles.summary: Salary taxed at a flat 10%. Starts with $300 less.

roles.name: Landlord
roles.summary: Always gets the Utility Control Bonus (1.5x). Cost of living doubled.
